items.title: Your controller's own page
items.detail: Live sticks and triggers, a stick test, its polling rate and the USB port it's on, for DualSense, Xbox and more.

items.title: Calibrate your sticks
items.detail: Your DualSense recenters and maps its sticks with its own routine, and Undo puts it back.

items.title: Edge profiles in Exo
items.detail: Edit your DualSense Edge's four profiles, stick curves, triggers and back buttons, stored in the controller.

items.title: Games read your controller
items.detail: One switch turns Steam Input off for every game that supports your PlayStation controller.

items.title: The right USB port
items.detail: Exo shows which devices go through the chipset and helps you find the processor's own ports.

items.title: Steadier shader compiles
items.detail: Exo Shaders takes SCSKiller 1.3.3's fixes: no compile stuck at 100%, and stopped ones pick up where they were.

items.title: Devices, each as itself
items.detail: Your mouse, keyboard, headphones and controller as cards with their real pictures; press one to open its page.

items.title: A page for your headphones
items.detail: Pick the pair you wear and set up Lucid, Game Mode and Night Shift on one screen.

items.title: Dictation
items.detail: Press the mic in a search box or Discord and talk; your words are typed on this PC, nothing leaves it.

items.title: PC, with game runtimes
items.detail: System is now PC, and its Apps page installs or repairs every runtime games need in one press.

items.title: Exo's own uninstaller
items.detail: PC › Apps uninstalls any app with a deep clean of what it leaves behind, shown before anything goes.

items.title: Music opens in one piece
items.detail: No more squares and jumps when Music first opens: it fades in whole.

items.title: Sharper Liquid Glass
items.detail: Cleaner glass edges, no scrollbars, and lists that fade into their panel instead of being cut off.

items.title: No clicks from Only my voice
items.detail: When it holds back a voice, it fades it out instead of cutting it off, so nobody in the call hears a click.

items.title: Hums stay out of the call
items.detail: A steady buzz near your mic no longer keeps it open, and Only my voice no longer switches itself off because of noise.

items.title: RTX Video sets like NVIDIA’s
items.detail: Super Resolution and HDR are changed the way NVIDIA Control Panel changes them, so the choice you make is the one that sticks.

items.title: The voice meter works again
items.detail: The microphone meter in Voice & video keeps moving, and Teach Exo my voice learns your voice again.

items.title: Your mic keeps going
items.detail: Only my voice can no longer mute you for a whole call: if it holds back most of your own speech, it stops and tells you.

items.title: Only my voice keeps learning
items.detail: After you teach it once, it learns from calls where it’s clearly you, and Settings shows how much it has learned.

items.title: Purges clear at once
items.detail: Messages a moderator’s bot purges disappear right away, and mentions name the person instead of @unknown-user.

items.title: New forum posts appear live
items.detail: A forum you have open shows new posts as they’re made.

items.title: Razer receivers connect
items.detail: Exo Mouse finds the right interface on a Razer receiver by itself.

items.title: A lighter Refresh
items.detail: Library’s Refresh skips the games you hid.

items.title: Exo Voice is Exo's own
items.detail: Noise suppression runs Exo's own AI end to end — Krisp is gone — and Hear your voice plays live exactly what the call sends.

items.title: A Store made for you
items.detail: Discover leads with games picked from what you play and wish for, marks why on each cover, and leaves out games you already own.

items.title: A release calendar
items.detail: The Store's Calendar shows what just came out and what's coming, your wishlist first.

items.title: Look into a voice channel
items.detail: Click a voice channel to see who's in it, who's live and whose camera is on before you join; double-click joins.

items.title: Stream volume
items.detail: While you watch someone's Go Live, their menu has Stream volume and Mute stream, as in Discord.

items.title: More from your friends
items.detail: Friends are playing shows eight games, games you don't have too, and a game played with Medal or Overwolf reads as the game.

items.title: Pictures send smaller
items.detail: Big images added to a Discord message are remade smaller before they upload, so they fit under the size limit.

items.title: Bigger reactions
items.detail: Reactions on Discord messages are larger and easier to read, and a role's colour can be any colour.

items.title: Recordings take less room
items.detail: While you aren't playing, Exo quietly re-saves your recordings at about a third of the size.

items.title: Portrait screens
items.detail: Library, Discord, System and Music keep their words and the player whole on a portrait screen or a narrow window.

items.title: Games on the fast chip
items.detail: On a laptop with two graphics chips, Exo can have every game run on the faster one.

items.title: Best settings in one press
items.detail: System › This PC sets your power plan, driver profile and HDR together.

items.title: HDR before the game starts
items.detail: Games that check for HDR only at launch now find it on.

items.title: Riot hours fix themselves
items.detail: VALORANT and League hours that were counted too high correct themselves on the next refresh.

items.title: GOG pauses keep their progress
items.detail: Pausing a GOG download no longer throws away what it already has.

items.title: More mice
items.detail: Exo Mouse now works with Scyrox and Hitscan mice, with updated Lamzu and Pulsar support.

items.title: Run your server from Exo
items.detail: Server Settings has every page Discord's does, from Access and Onboarding to invites, roles and the Server Guide.

items.title: Group DMs and video calls
items.detail: Start a group DM with up to nine friends, and video call anyone from your DM with them.

items.title: Bookmarks and reminders
items.detail: Save a message for later, or have Exo remind you about it, and find both in your Inbox.

items.title: Message requests
items.detail: DMs from people you don't know wait apart from your chats until you accept them.

items.title: Previews that play
items.detail: YouTube, Twitch, Vimeo, TikTok and SoundCloud links play right in the chat.

items.title: React in one press
items.detail: Your favorite reactions sit on every message, and a custom status shows what you're up to.

items.title: Honest compile times
items.detail: Shaders learns how long each game takes on your PC, and tells ready games apart.

items.title: Snips at once
items.detail: Snip opens instantly and stays light, even across several screens.

items.title: Thanks to snekxs
items.detail: Exo Mouse is built on OpenMouse, made by snekxs, and the Devices room now says so.

items.title: Starts lighter
items.detail: Exo opens sooner and uses about a third less memory: a room you don't open doesn't load.

items.title: Select several games
items.detail: Press Select in your Library to hide, file or uninstall many games at once.

items.title: Arrange your folders
items.detail: Drag a folder to move it, or use Move earlier and Move later on its menu.

items.title: Watch several streams
items.detail: Watch more than one friend's Go Live at a time, each with its own sound.

items.title: Streams that look and sound right
items.detail: Friends' streams show whole and stay sharp, and your stream carries your games and music, never your own voice.

items.title: Glass that stays glass
items.detail: Switching servers, Settings sections and pages keeps the glass clear the whole way.

items.title: The newest Exo Shaders
items.detail: Exo Shaders brings SCSKiller's newest improvements and sets each one up for you.

items.title: Clearer voice
items.detail: Fans, desk knocks and keyboard clicks are taken out of your mic, and your words aren't cut off.

items.title: Everyone at one volume
items.detail: Each person in a call comes through at about the same loudness, so one loud mic doesn't drown out the rest.

items.title: Noise suppression like Discord’s
items.detail: Pick Exo AI, Standard or None in Voice & Video, and Exo tells you when your mic sends nothing.

items.title: Driver updates on Radeon and Intel
items.detail: System keeps your AMD or Intel graphics driver up to date in one click, as it does on a GeForce.

items.title: Clearer glass
items.detail: Menus, sheets and buttons are clear glass now: the colors behind them show through, and their edges catch the light.

items.title: Your PC, checked
items.detail: System shows what's slowing your PC down, gives your PC a power plan tuned for its processor, and keeps your AMD or Intel chipset driver up to date.

items.title: Interrupts in one press
items.detail: System › This PC can move your graphics card, USB and network to MSI mode, so they don't wait on each other. Undo puts them back.

items.title: Exo's profile on Radeon and Intel
items.detail: An AMD Radeon or an Intel Arc gets the same one-press tuning as a GeForce, FSR 4 in FSR 3.1 games on a Radeon, and frame generation for the games you pick.

items.title: Discord stays fast
items.detail: Messages and profiles load instantly, even right after you switch windows.

items.title: Go Live your friends can watch
items.detail: Your stream plays smoothly on Discord's app, in sharper H.265 when everyone watching can play it.

items.title: Watch friends' streams
items.detail: Open a friend's Go Live and watch it right in Exo.

items.title: Lighter on your PC
items.detail: Calls with clips on and the streams you watch take far less of your processor and graphics card.

items.title: Discord, done right
items.detail: Every channel opens, chats open at the newest message, and links show as previews.

items.title: Light, Dark and Void
items.detail: Choose your look in Settings › General. Void is pure black, for OLED screens.

items.title: Gifts in your Library
items.detail: Games friends give you on Steam or Epic show in your Library, ready to accept in one click. Sign in to Steam once in Settings › Game stores.

items.title: Folders you can peek into
items.detail: Hover a folder and its games rise out of it.

items.title: Folders your way
items.detail: Sort each folder its own way, put a game in more than one folder, and give a folder a picture of your own.

items.title: Hide games
items.detail: Right-click a game and choose Hide to keep it out of your Library. Hidden games in the sort menu shows them again.

items.title: Sharper covers
items.detail: Game covers in your Library look as crisp as on the game's own page.

items.title: Fewer shader stutters
items.detail: Compiled shaders are kept on NVIDIA's newest drivers instead of being thrown away.

items.title: More mice
items.detail: Exo Mouse supports 40 more SteelSeries mice and keeps working after your PC sleeps.
